text: The author stipulates the term nominal confluence: legal requirements that are formally identical for mutual and hedge fund managers but that operate in materially different ways in practice, so formal legal convergence overstates actual convergence.
citation: Kaal, Confluence of Mutual and Private Funds (2016). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=2715083

isBasedOn.name: Confluence of Mutual and Private Funds

abstract: The term "nominal confluence" as used herein describes otherwise identical legal requirements for mutual and hedge fund managers that can be materially different in practice.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies where the same statute or rule governs both fund types
